budget_items.what_was_recorded: Business Manager noted Fitchburg's rate increase will be 7% a year for five years; John noted Barb had expected only 4% for Fitchburg.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Leominster may raise its rate and possibly its connection fees; the amount is not yet known.
budget_items.quote: leominster is potentially looking at a rate increase but she does not know how much yet.

budget_items.topic: Pump station and equipment upgrades (wish list)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: FY28 upgrades would require $700K; the Business Manager spread the cost over several years up to FY28 in a worksheet.
budget_items.quote: fy28 would require $700k for the upgrades but paula put together a worksheet

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Lower revenue than expected means only a $17K surplus at fiscal year end; the overall anticipated surplus is stated to the cent and goes to Retained Earnings.
budget_items.quote: the overall anticipated surplus will be $17,182.22, which will go into retained earnings.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Betterments expected over $42K, user fees under $53K, total revenues about $34K.
budget_items.quote: they anticipate being over $42k for betterments but under $53k for user fees, with total revenues about $34k.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Payroll expected over budget by $17K for vacation and sick-time payout, offset by $9K from an unfilled Assistant Business Manager position, leaving payroll short $8K.
budget_items.quote: payroll expenses will be over $17k, due to paying vacation and sick time to barb

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Usage fees budgeted at $732K; a high Leominster bill and higher Fitchburg bill mean usage fees are estimated over $85K for FY23.
